integrity: The source algorithm, local smoothness estimate, sufficient-decrease backtracking, adjustable checkpoint rule, and reported defaults were inspected directly. The theorem is proved algebraically from those displayed rules. Exact-rational computation is used only to replay the default checkpoint count and numerical factors.
limitations: The theorem is exact for unconstrained Euclidean normalized steepest descent on the scalar quadratic \(f(x)=\lambda x^2/2\). It does not establish a multidimensional absorbing band or compare total wall-clock performance, and it treats one-step termination at the lower band endpoint separately.
title: An absorbing one-backtrack band in adjustable ACGD, and a sharp scalar rate tradeoff
